attractions.name: Vinh Trang Pagoda
attractions.description: Late 19th-century temple blending Vietnamese, Chinese and European architecture, with peaceful gardens and large Buddha statues

attractions.name: Mekong River Cruise (My Tho)
attractions.description: Boat trip from My Tho past Dragon, Unicorn, Phoenix and Tortoise Islands

attractions.name: Unicorn Island
attractions.description: Orchard walks with tropical fruit tasting, traditional folk music, a hand-rowed sampan ride on Thoi Son Canal, a honey bee farm and a coconut candy workshop

attractions.name: Tan Thach Village
attractions.description: Rural village where visitors can cycle around the countryside and meet villagers

local_dishes.name: Coconut candy
local_dishes.description: Traditional Mekong coconut candy, made in local workshops

connectivity_tips.tip: Viettel has excellent coverage even in rural areas
